identity.display_name: P0 跨职业绝对标定实证采集与采纳包

capture_chain.canonicalization_rule: Raw evidence is preserved outside this package, canonically serialized by the approved external collector, digested, then submitted only by immutable reference.

stages.purpose: Bind every later observation to a real Y3 build, map or fixture revision, object inventory snapshot and read-only capture basis.
Collect source observations without object, map, Lua, UI, progress, economy or authority writes.
Produce a canonical artifact digest and a capture-basis digest that make replay, tamper and source drift checks possible.
Require a reviewer distinct from the collector to check completeness, provenance, determinism and rejection conditions.
Allow a separately authorized adoption authority to record a gate decision only after every gate-specific requirement is externally verified.

support_artifacts.rule: These are empty offline templates and source fingerprints. They are not an evidence ledger, a capture provider, an adoption decision or an absolute-field projection.

gate_scope_contract.rule: A submission has one exact, non-projecting gate_scope. It may classify external coverage but never carries raw logs, object keys, field bindings, values, rewards, receipts or an adoption decision.
gate_scope_contract.coverage_preview_rule: A frozen preview bundle contains exactly one gate and one engine/project/map/template/capture-basis family. Gate 01 can report coverage only when all 12 canonical profiles each carry run indices 1, 2 and 3 with matching input and canonical-log digests per profile. Gate 06 can report coverage only when member counts 1, 2, 3 and 4 are all present. Even a structurally complete preview remains blocked_provider_unavailable and is never an adoption decision.

required_evidence_classes: twelve complete fixed-build declarations for C01-C04 at Lv41/Lv55/Lv60
three distinct capture-run deterministic canonical action logs for every declared profile
equal fixture, input and canonical-log digests within each three-log set
read_only_capture_focus: baseline equipment, artifact, pet, collection and external-buff state
rejection_conditions: partial loadout or inferred learned ranks
fewer than three deterministic logs
mixed fixture, input or canonical-log digests
client-only combat claim
synthetic fixture presented as real evidence

required_evidence_classes: defense, mitigation and penetration ordering observations
formula revision, independent hold-out vectors and boundary counterexamples
rejection_conditions: using the named legacy physical fixture as a generic formula
missing magical or defense-order evidence
formula inferred from relative TianTing pressure
unknown formula branch

required_evidence_classes: target-rank and lifecycle basis plus independent hold-out vectors for every observation
read_only_capture_focus: hit, crit and control formula revision
rejection_conditions: UI or client outcome claim
borrowed target rank or lifecycle
generic control rule inferred from boss conversion
missing hit or control-resistance formula

required_evidence_classes: action start, begin, close and lock-end observations
read_only_capture_focus: windup, active, backswing, cancel and interval fields
observed distance and integer tick interval
rejection_conditions: copying design-space speed into an engine field
deriving frames from descriptive interval text
assuming zero windup outside the named legacy fixture
missing stable template readback

required_evidence_classes: safe landing, target-range and camera readability observations
rejection_conditions: diagram-only coordinate claim
candidate whitebox presented as real map evidence
missing camera or pathing record
captured result without source input trace

required_evidence_classes: one, two, three and four member authoritative replay captures
frozen member and encounter snapshot digests
accepted action and damage log digests
rejection_conditions: client-provided party size
duplicate actor lifecycle pair
rejoin after left or stale lifecycle
cleanup rewriting accepted final-damage evidence
fixture that implements or changes authority semantics

required_evidence_classes: field-reference and model, animation, effect and sound inventory readback
rejection_conditions: guessed object or template key
candidate diagram identifier presented as object key
resource name without inventory readback
object or resource write during collection

acceptance.rule: The package remains offline-only, production-gated closed and has no actual capture provider, project reference, ledger, adoption or projection payload.
The seven canonical P0 gates exactly match the parent calibration contract and all remain blocked pending external evidence.
Every collection plan uses a read-only capture focus, immutable external artifact reference and explicit rejection conditions.
A collector and reviewer must differ; client claims, synthetic fixtures and guessed identifiers never count as evidence.
Fixed-build evidence requires all twelve profiles and three deterministic canonical logs per profile before review may consider the gate.
Formula, frame, collision, replay and object-readback evidence cannot be inferred from relative TianTing values, diagrams or prose.
No submission may carry an object-field projection, gate-promotion decision, reward, receipt or economy input.
The offline reference model can reject malformed or untrusted submissions but cannot adopt a gate or create an absolute projection.
All absolute object fields, writes and economic outputs remain null until external evidence and a separate projection review are explicitly authorized.
The parent P0 contract is bound by byte-level SHA-256 and is the only canonical source of the ordered seven-gate taxonomy.

Submission previews require immutable external references, SHA-256-shaped digests, separate collector/reviewer identities and an external capture-provider proof; repeated runs and mixed revision families are rejected before any review outcome is considered.

Source fingerprints and collection/adoption templates remain empty offline scaffolds; no local template, schema test, construction preflight or discovery manifest can become an accepted evidence record.

Every preview submission has an exact allow-listed envelope and exact non-projecting gate scope; Gate 01 and Gate 06 coverage can be summarized structurally, but no preview result can become evidence, adoption or an absolute projection.
